post.summary: 校验 Source 连接配置
post.description: 仅校验协议配置结构，不连接设备、不保存配置或凭证
Requires uns.source on both the API Key and its owner. Returns protocol IDs, credential kinds and Source document templates. Source stores endpoint and credentials; acquisition belongs to Stream.

Requires uns.source.manage on both the API Key and its owner. Create a connection record with expectedRevision=0. Start with a document from source-protocols/list. Secrets must be written separately through credentials.
Requires uns.source on both the API Key and its owner. List, pagination and filters are supplied in the JSON body. IDs in the path must not be repeated in the body.

Requires uns.source.manage on both the API Key and its owner. Test a real connection. Supply saved sourceId to use its credentials, or an unsaved document. timeoutMs is 100..10000. Inspect data.health, not only HTTP status.

Requires uns.source.manage on both the API Key and its owner. Validate document without saving or connecting. A successful response contains valid=true and sideEffects=false; invalid configuration returns HTTP 400.

Requires uns.source.credentials on both the API Key and its owner. Write or replace credentials without returning their plaintext. Use expectedRevision and, for an in-use Source, confirmedImpactRevision. OAuth client secrets use kind=oauth2.
Requires uns.source.manage on both the API Key and its owner. Disable Source and remove dependent Streams before deletion. Use the latest revision and impactRevision.
Requires uns.source on both the API Key and its owner. Uses the same business validation and optimistic revision checks as the internal management API.
Requires uns.source.manage on both the API Key and its owner. Uses the same business validation and optimistic revision checks as the internal management API.
Requires uns.source on both the API Key and its owner. Uses the same business validation and optimistic revision checks as the internal management API.
Requires uns.source.credentials on both the API Key and its owner. Complete the previously started authorization using state and code. Never store codes or tokens in Stream scripts.

Requires uns.source.credentials on both the API Key and its owner. Start Authorization Code + PKCE. Returns an authorization URL; the user must approve access at the provider. redirectUri must match the registered callback.

Requires uns.source.manage on both the API Key and its owner. Replace the saved Source document using its current revision. Read impact and supply confirmedImpactRevision when changing an in-use connection.
Requires uns.stream on both the API Key and its owner. List, pagination and filters are supplied in the JSON body. IDs in the path must not be repeated in the body.
Requires uns.stream on both the API Key and its owner. Uses the same business validation and optimistic revision checks as the internal management API.

Requires uns.stream.manage on both the API Key and its owner. Create a draft with expectedRevision=0. A script Stream has model=script, script.code, script.timeoutMs and optional sources [{alias,sourceId,configRevision}].
Requires uns.stream on both the API Key and its owner. List, pagination and filters are supplied in the JSON body. IDs in the path must not be repeated in the body.

Requires uns.stream.manage on both the API Key and its owner. Run a draft test without publishing. A script subscription samples one message for up to 20 seconds and runs the callback; it does not leave a persistent subscription.
Requires uns.stream.manage on both the API Key and its owner. Validate the draft and bound Source revisions without publishing. An independent script uses expectedSourceRevision=0.
Requires uns.stream.manage on both the API Key and its owner. Disable an enabled Stream first, then delete with its latest expectedRevision.

Requires uns.stream.deploy on both the API Key and its owner. Publish an immutable version with expectedRevision. MQTT source.subscribe scripts start continuous subscriptions. Query detail for executionState and stream-runs/list for outcomes.
Requires uns.stream on both the API Key and its owner. Uses the same business validation and optimistic revision checks as the internal management API.
Requires uns.stream.deploy on both the API Key and its owner. Uses the same business validation and optimistic revision checks as the internal management API.
Requires uns.stream.manage on both the API Key and its owner. Uses the same business validation and optimistic revision checks as the internal management API.
Requires uns.stream on both the API Key and its owner. List, pagination and filters are supplied in the JSON body. IDs in the path must not be repeated in the body.

Requires uns.stream.deploy on both the API Key and its owner. Activate a saved version using streamId, versionId, expectedRevision and expectedSourceRevision; normal deployment validation still applies.

Requires uns.manage on both the API Key and its owner. Create a collection and its namespace Topic atomically. document requires name and recordSchema; sampleSchema is optional. Returns collection and topic.
Requires uns.read on both the API Key and its owner. List, pagination and filters are supplied in the JSON body. IDs in the path must not be repeated in the body.
Requires uns.read on both the API Key and its owner. List, pagination and filters are supplied in the JSON body. IDs in the path must not be repeated in the body.
Requires uns.read on both the API Key and its owner. List, pagination and filters are supplied in the JSON body. IDs in the path must not be repeated in the body.

Requires uns.manage on both the API Key and its owner. Save a folder, collection or Topic definition using kind and document. Create with expectedRevision=0; update using id and current revision. Source and Stream kinds are rejected.

Requires uns.manage on both the API Key and its owner. Delete or restore a metadata object using restore and expectedRevision. Delete additionally requires uns.delete; referenced objects cannot be deleted.
Requires uns.read on both the API Key and its owner. Uses the same business validation and optimistic revision checks as the internal management API.

Requires uns.manage on both the API Key and its owner. Create a UUID-based namespace Topic. document contains name and optional description, parentId, collectionId or fields. No metric type is selected. expectedRevision must be zero.
Requires uns.read on both the API Key and its owner. List, pagination and filters are supplied in the JSON body. IDs in the path must not be repeated in the body.
Requires uns.manage on both the API Key and its owner. Validate Topic fields, referenced collections and parent hierarchy without writing. Supply id and expectedRevision when validating an update.
Requires uns.read on both the API Key and its owner. Read a UUID-based Topic definition and resolved bound field values. For collection-backed data use the collection records or samples query.
Requires uns.manage on both the API Key and its owner. Replace the Topic document using its current expectedRevision. Existing Topic ID is a UUID; use this facade for metadata Topics.

post.description: 跨授权 Collection 编排 query/check/read/create/update/replace/delete 和结果绑定，整批原子提交。record.query 的 query 支持 filter、sort、limit（默认20，最多100）、expectCount.min/max（limit前总匹配数断言）。后续项可绑定 id=query.records.N.id，仅同一 Collection，省略静态 id；同一记录只写一次。查询型事务采用可串行化隔离和记录锁，冲突整体回滚，不跳过锁定行；不支持事务内联表聚合或 allowPartial。普通同类操作使用资源接口 items 数组。幂等键可选，accepted 按 jobId 查询；超时先核对业务状态。

$group.description: _id 指定单值、null 或对象分组键；其余字段支持 $sum/$avg/$min/$max。计数用 {$sum:1}。

$count.description: 合法顶层输出字段名，遵循统一路径转义及保留名规则。 输出一行计数；空输入返回 0。作为末阶段时禁止显式 page，后面还有阶段时按最终结果正常分页。
